views.name: traces
views.description: One row per trace. Merge bookkeeping columns are not exposed.

columns.name: trace_id
columns.description: Trace id, 16 bytes as lowercase hex.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Name of the root span, else the earliest span.

columns.name: root_span_id
columns.description: Span id of the root. Null when the trace has no root.

columns.name: has_root
columns.description: Whether a root span is present.

columns.name: status
columns.description: error if any span errored, else the root status, else unset.

columns.name: metadata
columns.description: Root metadata, with keys from other spans added when absent.

columns.name: input_preview
columns.description: Root input preview, else the first llm span's.

columns.name: output_preview
columns.description: Root output preview, else the first llm span's.

columns.name: error_count
columns.description: Number of spans with status error.

columns.name: input_tokens
columns.description: Sum of input tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: output_tokens
columns.description: Sum of output tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: cache_read_tokens
columns.description: Sum of cache-read tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: cache_write_tokens
columns.description: Sum of cache-write tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: reasoning_tokens
columns.description: Sum of reasoning tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: total_tokens
columns.description: Sum of total tokens. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: cost_total
columns.description: Sum of span costs, USD. Null when every span omitted the field.

columns.name: prompts
columns.description: Registry prompts the trace used, as name@version (D-V-15).

views.name: spans
views.description: One row per span, including payload columns.

columns.name: trace_id
columns.description: Trace id, 16 bytes as lowercase hex.

columns.name: span_id
columns.description: Span id, 8 bytes as lowercase hex.

columns.name: parent_span_id
columns.description: Parent span id. Null when the span was received as a root.

columns.name: span_kind
columns.description: Kind of work: llm, embedding, tool, agent, chain, retriever, reranker, guardrail, evaluator, or span.

columns.name: environment
columns.description: Deployment environment. cetra-eval is reserved for evaluator runs, cetra-playground for playground runs and cetra-assistant for assistant turns.

columns.name: metadata
columns.description: User metadata. Values are JSON-encoded scalars or strings.

columns.name: provider
columns.description: Normalized provider name, for example openai or anthropic.

columns.name: cost_total
columns.description: Total cost, USD, including cache and reasoning.

columns.name: request_params
columns.description: Request parameters such as temperature and max_tokens.

columns.name: input_preview
columns.description: First 512 characters of the plain-text rendering.

columns.name: output_preview
columns.description: First 512 characters of the plain-text rendering.

columns.name: attributes
columns.description: Span attributes not consumed by normalization. Values are JSON-encoded.

columns.name: resource_attributes
columns.description: Resource attributes except service.name. Values are JSON-encoded.

columns.name: events
columns.description: Span events. Each item has time, name, and attributes.

columns.name: links
columns.description: Span links. Each item has trace_id, span_id, and attributes.

columns.name: media_refs
columns.description: SHA-256 hex of extracted media blobs.

columns.name: truncated
columns.description: Names of attributes truncated at ingest.

columns.name: conventions
columns.description: Detected conventions, for example genai or openinference.

columns.name: trace_count
columns.description: Number of traces in the session.

columns.name: trace_id
columns.description: Trace id for a span or trace target.

columns.name: span_id
columns.description: Span id for a span target.

columns.name: session_id
columns.description: Session id for a session target, and copied for a trace target when known.

columns.name: user_id
columns.description: End-user id, when the writer knew it.

columns.name: source
columns.description: api, sdk, human, end_user, llm_judge, check, webhook or issue.

columns.name: rule_id
columns.description: Online rule that produced the score.

columns.name: dataset_item_id
columns.description: Dataset item the score belongs to.

columns.name: queue_id
columns.description: Annotation queue the score was written from.

columns.name: author_user_id
columns.description: Person who annotated, for human scores.

views.name: experiment_items
views.description: One row per experiment result (item × repetition) of the project's visible experiments.

columns.name: dataset_id
columns.description: Dataset the experiment ran on; null once the dataset is deleted.

columns.name: dataset_item_id
columns.description: Dataset item id, stable across versions.

columns.name: trace_id
columns.description: Trace of the task run, lowercase hex; null when none was reported.

columns.name: input
columns.description: Item input at the pinned version, JSON text.

columns.name: expected_output
columns.description: Expected output at the pinned version, JSON text; null when absent.

columns.name: output
columns.description: Task output, JSON text; null when the run failed.

columns.name: error
columns.description: Error text of the failed run; null when the run did not fail.

columns.name: latency_ns
columns.description: Task run time in nanoseconds, as the SDK measured it.

views.name: dataset_items
views.description: Live items of each dataset at its current version.

columns.name: dataset_version
columns.description: Current version of the dataset, the version these rows belong to.

columns.name: item_id
columns.description: Dataset item id, stable across versions.

columns.name: expected_output
columns.description: Expected output, JSON text; null when absent.

columns.name: source_trace_id
columns.description: Trace the item was created from, lowercase hex; null when none.

columns.name: source_span_id
columns.description: Span the item was created from, lowercase hex; null when none.

columns.name: created_at
columns.description: Time the item revision was stored.

functions.name: lower
functions.description: Lowercase a string.

functions.name: upper
functions.description: Uppercase a string.

functions.name: length
functions.description: Number of UTF-8 characters.

functions.name: substr
functions.signature: substr(value: string, start: integer [, count: integer]) -> string
functions.description: Extract a substring (1-based start).

functions.name: trim
functions.description: Trim leading and trailing characters.

functions.name: ltrim
functions.description: Trim leading characters.

functions.name: rtrim
functions.description: Trim trailing characters.

functions.name: left
functions.description: First n characters of a string.

functions.name: right
functions.description: Last n characters of a string.

functions.name: split_part
functions.signature: split_part(value: string, delimiter: string, part: integer) -> string
functions.description: Split a string and return the 1-based part.

functions.name: concat
functions.description: Concatenate values as a string.

functions.name: concat_ws
functions.description: Concatenate non-null values with a separator.

functions.name: starts_with
functions.description: Whether value starts with prefix.

functions.name: ends_with
functions.description: Whether value ends with suffix.

functions.name: contains
functions.description: Whether value contains substring.

functions.name: strpos
functions.description: 1-based position of substring, or 0 if absent.

functions.name: regexp_like
functions.signature: regexp_like(value: string, pattern: string [, flags: string]) -> boolean
functions.description: Whether value matches a regular expression.

functions.name: regexp_extract
functions.signature: regexp_extract(value: string, pattern: string [, flags: string]) -> string
functions.description: Extract the first match or capture group.

functions.name: encode
functions.signature: encode(value: binary | string, encoding: string) -> string
functions.description: Encode bytes using hex or base64.

functions.name: now
functions.description: Current query timestamp.

functions.name: date_trunc
functions.description: Truncate a timestamp to a unit such as day or hour.

functions.name: date_bin
functions.signature: date_bin(stride: interval, time: timestamp [, origin: timestamp]) -> timestamp
functions.description: Bin a timestamp to fixed stride boundaries.

functions.name: extract
functions.signature: extract(field: string, value: timestamp | date | interval) -> integer | float
functions.description: Extract a calendar field from a timestamp, date, or interval.

functions.name: to_timestamp
functions.signature: to_timestamp(value: integer | float | string | timestamp) -> timestamp
functions.description: Convert epoch seconds or string to a UTC timestamp.

functions.name: abs
functions.description: Absolute value.

functions.name: round
functions.description: Round a number to digits decimal places.

functions.name: floor
functions.description: Largest integer not greater than value.

functions.name: ceil
functions.description: Smallest integer not less than value.

functions.name: sqrt
functions.description: Square root.

functions.name: ln
functions.description: Natural logarithm.

functions.name: log10
functions.description: Base-10 logarithm.

functions.name: power
functions.description: Raise base to exponent.

functions.name: coalesce
functions.description: First non-null argument.

functions.name: nullif
functions.description: Return null when a equals b, else a.

functions.name: greatest
functions.description: Largest non-null argument.

functions.name: least
functions.description: Smallest non-null argument.

functions.name: isnan
functions.description: Whether value is IEEE NaN.

functions.name: isfinite
functions.description: Whether value is finite (not NaN or infinite).

functions.name: array_has
functions.description: Whether the list contains the value.

functions.name: array_has_all
functions.description: Whether array contains every element of subset.

functions.name: array_length
functions.description: Number of elements.

functions.name: array_element
functions.description: 1-based element of a list.

functions.name: array_to_string
functions.signature: array_to_string(array: list, delimiter: string [, null_str: string]) -> string
functions.description: Join list elements into a string.

functions.name: array_distinct
functions.description: Remove duplicate elements from a list.

functions.name: map_keys
functions.description: Sorted keys of a string map.

functions.name: map_values
functions.description: Values of a string map in key order.

functions.name: json_get
functions.signature: json_get(json: string, key: string | integer) -> string
functions.description: Get JSON object field or array element as JSON text.

functions.name: json_get_text
functions.signature: json_get_text(json: string, key: string | integer) -> string
functions.description: Get JSON object field or array element as unquoted text.

functions.name: json_extract
functions.description: Extract JSONPath value as JSON text.

functions.name: json_extract_text
functions.description: Extract JSONPath value as unquoted text.

functions.name: count
functions.description: Count rows or non-null values.

functions.name: sum
functions.description: Sum of non-null values.

functions.name: avg
functions.description: Arithmetic mean of non-null values.

functions.name: min
functions.description: Minimum non-null value.

functions.name: max
functions.description: Maximum non-null value.

functions.name: approx_percentile_cont
functions.description: Approximate continuous percentile via DDSketch.

functions.name: percentile_cont
functions.signature: percentile_cont(quantile: float) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY value) -> float
functions.description: Exact interpolated continuous percentile.

functions.name: bool_or
functions.description: True if any non-null value is true.

functions.name: bool_and
functions.description: True if all non-null values are true.

functions.name: array_agg
functions.description: Collect non-null values into a list.

functions.name: row_number
functions.description: Sequential 1-based row number within each partition.

functions.name: rank
functions.description: 1-based rank with gaps for ties.

functions.name: dense_rank
functions.description: 1-based rank without gaps for ties.

functions.name: lag
functions.signature: lag(value: any [, offset: integer [, default: any]]) OVER (...) -> any
functions.description: Value from a preceding row in the partition.

functions.name: lead
functions.signature: lead(value: any [, offset: integer [, default: any]]) OVER (...) -> any
functions.description: Value from a following row in the partition.

functions.name: first_value
functions.description: Value at the first row of the window frame.

functions.name: last_value
functions.description: Value at the last row of the window frame.

functions.name: score
functions.description: Latest numeric score of that name on the row's target.

functions.name: score_label
functions.description: Latest categorical or text score of that name.

functions.name: has_score
functions.description: Whether the row's target has a score of that name.
